headline: Apple Expands US Component Sourcing to Nearly 100 iPhone Parts Under Program
summary: Apple's American Manufacturing Program now supplies nearly 100 domestic parts for the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro lines, expanding its US-based component supply chain.
why: Apple is the largest tech company by market capitalization, and its supply chain realignments impact global semiconductor and component manufacturers.

impacts.name: Apple Inc.
impacts.why: Increasing domestic part procurement diversifies supply chain risks while potentially raising unit costs.
